_README: Agent 1 OUTPUT CONTRACT. Agent 1 extracts FACTS only — never ASC 606 judgments. Each field shows its data type. This schema follows Agent 1's existing output structure; fields marked [NEW] are the gaps to add so Agent 2 has the facts it needs. Convention: null = not stated in contract; false = explicitly absent.
implementation_standardized_or_optional: boolean | null   [NEW] needed for KB2_3 distinct exception

fees.name: string  (fee label as written; must be the actual fee name, not contract prose)
fees.fee_type: string (subscription | implementation | support | other) | null   [NEW] helps Agent 2 map fees to POs

usage_fee.minimum_or_base_fee: number | null   [NEW] committed floor, needed for KB2_5
usage_fee.is_ip_license_usage: boolean | null   [NEW] usage of RevLens IP, needed for KB2_7 royalty

discount._README: [NEW BLOCK] Agent 1 does not currently extract discounts. Needed for KB1_14 / KB2_8.
discount.discount_amount: number | null   (sum of list prices - total consideration)

renewal_terms.standard_or_list_price: number | null   [NEW] comparable price, needed for KB1_15/KB2_10 material right

_out_of_scope_for_agent1._README: These are Agent 2 JUDGMENTS (ASC 606 conclusions), NOT facts. Agent 1 must NOT emit them.
_out_of_scope_for_agent1.discount_type: KB1_14 / KB2_8 classification (pro-rata / directed / residual) — Agent 2
